# pangolin_event_streaming_destination (Resource)

Manages an event streaming destination of the org (Pangolin 1.24+, Enterprise): Pangolin pushes the selected logs to it in batches every 30 seconds. Only logs written after the destination is created are sent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Push Pangolin's access and action logs to VictoriaLogs (JSON lines API).
resource "pangolin_event_streaming_destination" "victorialogs" {
  type = "http"
  config = jsonencode({
    name             = "victorialogs"
    url              = "https://logs.example.com/insert/jsonline?_msg_field=data.action&_time_field=timestamp&_stream_fields=event"
    authType         = "basic"
    basicCredentials = "pangolin:${var.victorialogs_password}"
    headers          = []
    format           = "ndjson"
    useBodyTemplate  = false
  })
  send_access_logs = true
  send_action_logs = true
}

# Archive every log type to an S3-compatible bucket.
resource "pangolin_event_streaming_destination" "archive" {
  type = "s3"
  config = jsonencode({
    name            = "archive"
    accessKeyId     = var.s3_access_key
    secretAccessKey = var.s3_secret_key
    region          = "us-east-1"
    bucket          = "pangolin-logs"
    endpoint        = "https://s3.example.com"
    format          = "ndjson"
    gzip            = true
  })
  send_request_logs    = true
  send_action_logs     = true
  send_access_logs     = true
  send_connection_logs = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String, Sensitive) The destination settings as a JSON object; build it with `jsonencode`. Stored encrypted, sensitive because it holds credentials.

- `http`: `name`, `url`, `authType` (`none`, `bearer`, `basic`, `custom`), `bearerToken`, `basicCredentials` (`user:password`), `customHeaderName`, `customHeaderValue`, `headers` (list of `{key, value}`), `format` (`json_array` default, `ndjson`, `json_single`), `useBodyTemplate`, `bodyTemplate` (placeholders `{{event}}`, `{{timestamp}}`, `{{data}}`).
- `s3`: `name`, `accessKeyId`, `secretAccessKey`, `region`, `bucket`, `prefix`, `endpoint` (S3-compatible storage), `format`, `gzip`.
- `type` (String) `http` (POST to a URL) or `s3` (objects in an S3-compatible bucket).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether logs are sent. Defaults to `true`.
- `send_access_logs` (Boolean) Send the access logs (authentication decisions on resources). Defaults to `false`.
- `send_action_logs` (Boolean) Send the action logs (changes made in the org). Defaults to `false`.
- `send_ai_session_logs` (Boolean) Send the AI session logs. Defaults to `false`.
- `send_connection_logs` (Boolean) Send the connection logs (client and site tunnel connections). Defaults to `false`.
- `send_request_logs` (Boolean) Send the request logs (every proxied HTTP request). Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The numeric destination ID.
- `last_error` (String) The last send error, null while the destination is healthy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an event streaming destination by its numeric ID.
terraform import pangolin_event_streaming_destination.victorialogs <destination_id>
```
